onscreen_lines.desc: Ice Maker with Bin at Vista Ridge High School (including delivery, installation, removal & disposal services)
onscreen_lines.note: Model: IYF1900N/JCT1500/F-1300SG Model: IDT1900N263/JCT1500/F-1325SG Stainless steel bin. Stainless steel legs. Provide bin adapter kit as required. Provide Luminice II Virus and Bacteria Inhibitor. Provide sizes and quantities as required: Dormont s/s water disconnect from filter to Ice Machine. One (1) pre-filter and water filter sized to manufacturers recommendations. Provide two (2) sets of replacement filters. Mount on wall adjacent to ice machine in an easily accessible location. Coordinate cord and cap with receptacle. Water supply to filter to be hard copper plumbed. 60" long flex hose from filter to ice maker. Interconnection thru water filter to ice machine and final connection by Division 22. Water filter overflow tube to be strapped to back side of ice machine and extend to 1" above floor sink. Remote condenser to be 208 volt single phase. To be located in same spot as existing unit. Provide 2" insulation on refrigerant lines to and from ice maker. Provide all tubing as required for a complete system. Ice maker to be 208 volt three phase, Div. 26 to provide stainless steel disconnect switch. Provide scope, paddle and holding racks for both. Coordinate installation with ceiling grids, adjust as required *Please see updated spec in the Attatchements Tab titled "OCR Addendum No 3.1 - LISD - PACKAGE 2 - ICE MACHINES_8.20.2026.pdf" **Quoted price must be separated out to clearly identify the product cost, delivery cost, installation cost, and removal & disposal cost. Failure to clearly itemize all required pricing components may result in the proposal being deemed non-responsive.
